subject: Tenant federation onboarding and term negotiation
messages:
From: Amira Patel <amira@novuscare.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T10:15:00Z
Subject: Tenant federation onboarding + renewal timing

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're heading into renewal conversations for our Redwood Private deployment and need to lock a plan for tenant federation. Two asks: (1) we need an additional isolated compute cluster for the new patient-data ingestion pipeline (HIPAA scope) and (2) we'd like to extend terms by 12 months but also request a 99.99% SLA for that cluster due to clinical SLAs.

High-level timeline: procurement conversation kicks off 3/1, target cutover for the new tenant is 4/15. Can you pull together a mutual action plan (MAM) with an estimated cost delta and any compliance evidence we need to show procurement? If there's a quicker way to get an SLA exception approved, let me know — that would help our executive sponsor.

Thanks,
Amira Patel
VP Engineering, NovusCare
[phone redacted]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Patel <amira@novuscare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Tenant federation onboarding + renewal timing

Amira — thanks for the clear asks. Looping in Marissa (CS) and Dev (Solutions) to help scope and land the MAM and a recommended SLA path. Quick notes up front:

- We can provision an isolated cluster in the same VPC or as an adjacent private cluster depending on your network isolation requirement. The former is faster (~3 weeks), the latter gives stronger tenancy separation (~5-7 weeks).
- SLA changes for isolated clusters typically go through a cross-functional review (SRE + Legal); we can use a time-boxed escalation for procurement to make the 4/15 target, but we'll need an approved SOW and capacity commit.

Marissa — can you draft a 3-phase MAM (discovery, provision, cutover) with milestone owners and the pricing delta? Dev — can you sketch the recommended cluster topology and the minimal firewall/network changes we need from NovusCare? Amira, if procurement has a preferred legal contact or SOW template, send it over and we'll align.

I'll aim to have a first-pass MAM and cost rough order of magnitude by 2/24.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Amira Patel <amira@novuscare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-22T14:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Tenant federation onboarding + renewal timing — topology options + capacity workbook

Hi all,

See attached two artifacts: capacity_workbook_v3.xlsx and network_requirements_v1.pdf. Summary of recommended options below.

Option A — Shared VPC, isolated Node pool (faster):
- Provision a dedicated node pool with strict network policies and RBAC.
- Pros: ~3 week lead time, lower infra delta, easier ops.
- Cons: weaker tenant isolation; acceptable if NovusCare DLP scope is limited to application-level separation.

Option B — Dedicated Private Cluster (strong isolation):
- Separate cluster, private control plane, optional air-gapped egress.
- Pros: best tenancy separation, cleaner audit trails.
- Cons: 5–7 week lead time and ~25-40% higher recurring infra cost.

SLA notes: to reach 99.99% for the new tenant we recommend a dedicated cluster with cross-region failover and reserved capacity (burst pool). That ties to a committed monthly spend in the contract. I've put a baseline BOM in the workbook and a quick sensitivity table showing cost vs availability.

Network and procurement items we need from NovusCare: public IP allowlist for provisioning, an endpoint for KMS integration (if you want customer-managed keys), and a named procurement/legal contact for SOW.

[Attachment: capacity_workbook_v3.xlsx]
[Attachment: network_requirements_v1.pdf]

— Dev

Subject: RE: Tenant federation onboarding + renewal timing — pricing and proposed terms

Amira — following up with a pricing and term proposal attached (renewal_pricing_proposal.pdf). Key items:

- Proposed term: 12-month extension (aligned with your request).
- Provisioning plan: Phase 1 (shared VPC/isolated node pool) to meet aggressive cutover target; Phase 2 (dedicated private cluster) to be completed within 90 days post-cutover if you elect stronger isolation.
- SLA: We can offer a 99.99% SLA on a dedicated cluster with a reserved capacity commitment (minimum monthly commitment: $85k). We are prepared to propose a cross-functional SLA exception for legal review if NovusCare signs the Phase 1 MOP and the reserved commit concurrently.

I've added milestone-based payments in the SOW and a DocuSign envelope link for expedited signature. If procurement wants a PO first, we'll accept a PO with a 60-day contract execution window.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/EXAMPLE-7fa3

Best,

Marissa / Sean,

Thanks — NovusCare procurement is ready to move. We prefer Option B (dedicated private cluster) for the HIPAA tenant. We'll aim to process a PO this week and target DocuSign for the SOW by 3/3. Legal contact for PO/SOW: Liam O'Neill, Procurement (liam.oneill@novuscare.com).

A few clarifications before we sign:
- Can Redwood confirm the timeline for a dedicated cluster with reserved capacity (start date after PO + 14 business days or calendar?)
- We will require customer-managed KMS — can you confirm supported KMS vendors and if any HSM integration lead times apply?

If you can confirm those two items in writing I'll route the PO. Also — please escalate the SLA exception path internally; our exec sponsor will need the SLA commitment in the finalized SOW.

Regards,
Liam O'Neill
